metadata.title: О SavDown
metadata.description: SavDown — спокойный загрузчик из социальных сетей с минимальным количеством рекламы, созданный небольшой командой, которая заботится о дизайне, приватности и скорости.

hero.title: Инструменты должны ощущаться спокойно.
hero.lead: SavDown начался с простой наблюдения: все загрузчики, которые мы пробовали, были испещрены рекламой, тёмными приёмами и сомнительными всплывающими окнами. Мы хотели противоположного — инструмент, который напоминает самые спокойные приложения Apple.

mission.title: Сделать сохранение контента простым для каждого.
paragraphs: Мы считаем, что загрузка видео, сохранение фото или извлечение аудио должны быть такими же простыми, как копирование ссылки. Никакой регистрации, никаких платных стен, никакого подозрительного ПО. Просто вставьте ссылку, выберите и сохраните.
Наша цель — веб, где каждый создатель, студент, исследователь и обычный пользователь имеет доступ к чистым, приватным инструментам, которые уважают их время и данные.

items.question: Is SavDown free?
items.answer: Yes, every downloader on SavDown is free to use with no signup, no watermarks, and no download caps.

items.question: Do you save my downloads?
items.answer: No. We route the media stream and never store the file on our servers. Your history is your own.

items.question: What platforms are supported?
items.answer: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, and X are all supported, each with its own dedicated downloader.

items.question: Can I download private or copyrighted content?
items.answer: No. Only public content, and only content you own or have explicit permission to download. Please respect creators.

items.question: Do you have an app?
items.answer: SavDown is web-first, no install needed. Works on any modern browser, mobile or desktop.

items.question: What formats are supported?
items.answer: MP4 up to 4K, MP3 audio extraction, image thumbnails, and platform-specific formats where applicable.

metadata.title: Cookie Policy
metadata.description: How SavDown uses cookies and similar technologies — minimally, transparently, and only when needed.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy.
cookiesPage.description: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. SavDown uses the minimum number necessary to make the service work well — nothing more.

essentialSection.title: Required for the service to work.
essentialSection.body: These are required for basic functionality and cannot be turned off. They store no personal data beyond what is necessary for the feature they support.

essentialCookies.name: next-auth.session-token
essentialCookies.purpose: Keeps you signed in across pages.

analyticsSection.title: Only if you opt in.
analyticsSection.body: If enabled, we use privacy-friendly aggregate analytics to understand which tools are used most. You can opt out at any time. We do not use Google Analytics by default.

analyticsBlocks.title: Aggregate only
analyticsBlocks.description: We see which tool is popular, not who used it. No per-user profiles, ever.

analyticsBlocks.title: Opt out anytime
analyticsBlocks.description: Toggle analytics off from the cookie banner. Your choice is remembered for one year.

analyticsBlocks.title: No cross-site tracking
analyticsBlocks.description: We do not run retargeting pixels, ad networks, or third-party trackers of any kind.

notUsedSection.title: A short list, kept short on purpose.

choicesBlocks.title: Browser controls
choicesBlocks.description: You can clear cookies at any time through your browser settings. Note that clearing essential cookies will sign you out.

choicesBlocks.title: Cookie banner
choicesBlocks.description: The first time you visit, you will see a banner that explains what we use and lets you opt out of anything non-essential.

callout.title: Questions about cookies?
callout.body: Read our privacy policy or reach out — we are happy to explain anything in plain English.

metadata.title: DMCA Policy
metadata.description: SavDown's DMCA takedown policy and how to submit a notice — clear, fast, and creator-friendly.

dmcaPage.title: DMCA Policy.
dmcaPage.description: SavDown respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects users to do the same. Here is how we handle copyright concerns, in plain language.

contextSection.title: What SavDown actually does.
contextSection.body: SavDown does not host, store, or index copyrighted content. We are a tool that facilitates user-directed downloads. The actual media resides on the source platforms (YouTube, TikTok, etc.).

contextBlocks.title: We do not host
contextBlocks.description: No media file is stored on SavDown's servers. The download streams directly from the source.

contextBlocks.title: Public content only
contextBlocks.description: We only resolve public URLs. Private, restricted, or DRM-protected content is out of scope.

contextBlocks.title: Cooperative takedowns
contextBlocks.description: Valid DMCA notices are actioned within 72 hours and we keep records to handle repeat infringers.

noticeSection.title: A complete DMCA notice includes:
noticeSection.body: If you are a copyright owner (or an authorized agent) and believe SavDown is being used to infringe your copyright, your notice must include the following six elements:

noticeItems: A physical or electronic signature of the copyright owner or authorized agent.
Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed.
Identification of the material to be removed and information reasonably sufficient to locate it.
Your contact information (address, phone number, email).
A statement of good-faith belief that use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
A statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information in the notice is accurate and that you are authorized to act on behalf of the copyright owner.

processSection.title: Where to send it, and what comes next.

processBlocks.title: Where to send
processBlocks.description: Submit notices via our contact form with subject line "DMCA Notice", or email our designated agent at dmca@savdown.com.

processBlocks.title: Counter-notices
processBlocks.description: If you believe your content was removed in error, you may submit a counter-notice including identification of the material, a statement under penalty of perjury, and consent to jurisdiction.

processBlocks.title: Repeat infringers
processBlocks.description: We terminate accounts of users who are found to be repeat infringers, in accordance with the DMCA and applicable law.

processBlocks.title: Response time
processBlocks.description: Valid notices are reviewed and actioned within 72 hours. We send a confirmation email once a determination is made.

callout.title: Need to file a notice?
callout.body: Use our contact form with the subject "DMCA Notice" and we will route it to the designated agent immediately.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: How SavDown handles your data — clearly, honestly, and with respect for your privacy.

privacyPage.title: Your Privacy, Respected.
privacyPage.description: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains, in plain English, what data SavDown collects, why we collect it, and how it is handled.

principlesSection.title: Four promises we keep.
principlesSection.body: These are the principles we measure every decision against. If a feature violates one, we do not ship it.

principles.title: We never store your downloads
principles.description: The media files you download stream directly from the source. They never touch our disk.

principles.title: We do not track you
principles.description: No cross-site trackers, no ad pixels, no fingerprinting. We never sell or share your data.

principles.title: Minimal data only
principles.description: We collect the bare minimum needed to operate the service — and clearly explain each piece.

principles.title: You are in control
principles.description: Access, correct, or delete your data at any time. We respond to requests within 30 days.

collectSection.title: The minimum, clearly explained.
collectSection.body: Every data point below serves a specific purpose. If we cannot justify a piece of data, we do not collect it.

collect.title: URLs you paste
collect.body: Only for the duration of resolving your download. We cache metadata (title, thumbnail, formats) for up to 30 minutes to speed up repeat requests, then discard it.

collect.title: Anonymous usage data
collect.body: IP address hash, user agent, tool used, and timestamp — used only for rate limiting and aggregate analytics. Never linked back to you.

collect.title: Account data (if you sign in)
collect.body: Email, name, and profile image from your OAuth provider. Nothing more. We never ask for passwords.

collect.title: Newsletter data (if you subscribe)
collect.body: Just your email — used to send you the calm monthly update and absolutely nothing else.

notCollectSection.title: The list is short. On purpose.

notCollectItems: The actual media files you download
Personal data sold to third parties

detailBlocks.title: Cookies
detailBlocks.description: We use essential cookies for sign-in and rate limiting. Optional analytics only if you consent — see our Cookie Policy for the full list.

detailBlocks.title: Data retention
detailBlocks.description: Download logs are kept for 90 days for abuse prevention, then deleted. Account data lives as long as your account exists.

detailBlocks.title: Third parties
detailBlocks.description: We use OAuth providers (Google, GitHub) for sign-in, Vercel for delivery, and a media-resolver micro-service. None of them receive personal data beyond what their function requires.

rightsSection.title: You own your data. Always.
rightsSection.body: We make it easy to exercise your rights — no support tickets, no waiting on hold.

rights.title: Right to access
rights.body: Ask what data we hold on you and we will send you a copy.

rights.title: Right to correct
rights.body: See something wrong? We will fix inaccurate information within 30 days.

rights.title: Right to delete
rights.body: One email and your account and all related data are gone — no hoops, no friction.

rights.title: Right to opt out
rights.body: Decline optional analytics cookies, refuse marketing emails, and turn off anything non-essential.

callout.title: Privacy questions? Just ask.
callout.body: Reach us via the contact page and we will respond within 30 days — usually much faster.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service.
termsPage.description: By using SavDown, you agree to these terms. We have written them in plain English so you do not need a lawyer to understand them.

summaryBlocks.title: Use SavDown freely
summaryBlocks.description: The service is free for personal, educational, and fair-use downloading of content you have the right to save.

acceptableItems: Downloading content you own or created yourself.
Downloading content licensed under Creative Commons or in the public domain.
Downloading content where the copyright holder has given you explicit permission.
Fair use activities such as education, commentary, or research where legally permitted.

prohibitedSection.body: You may not use SavDown for any of the following:

prohibitedItems: Downloading copyrighted content without permission from the rights holder.
Redistributing downloaded content commercially without a license.
Circumventing digital rights management (DRM) or technical protection measures.
Overwhelming our service with automated requests or scraping.
Violating the terms of service of any source platform (YouTube, TikTok, etc.).

otherBlocks.title: Intellectual property
otherBlocks.description: SavDown does not host, store, or claim ownership over any downloaded content. All content remains the property of its original creators. SavDown is a tool — how you use it is your responsibility.

otherBlocks.title: Service availability

faqs.question: What is a credit?
faqs.answer: A credit is what you spend on a single download. Most downloads cost 1 credit; 4K and future AI tools cost a little more. Your daily free credits reset every 24 hours.

faqs.question: Do free credits roll over?
faqs.answer: Free daily credits reset each day. Credits from a Pro plan or a one-time Credit Pack do not expire.

faqs.question: What are the AI tools?
